#Module images

  • handle HTMLImageElement : Element

Images: HTMLImageElement (<img> and <input type=image>) and decoding image files from buffers. naturalWidth and naturalHeight are density-corrected CSS pixels (0 until the image is available).

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/images.widl.

#Types

#handle HTMLImageElement : Element

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_HTMLImageElement).

#HTMLImageElement_decode

Promise HTMLImageElement_decode(HTMLImageElement image)

image.decode(): settles (value 0) once decoded at its natural size; rejected with Encoding when it is broken or its source changes first.

Host: HTMLImageElement_decode :: proc(c: ^Call, image: Api_HTMLImageElement) -> u64

#Image_decode

Promise<Buffer> Image_decode(Buffer data)

Decodes an image file (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF, WebP / AVIF where the codecs exist) on the decoding threads: settles with a buffer of RGBA8 pixels (straight alpha, sRGB, rows top-down) as value and "<width>x<height>" as text (first frame of an animation). Rejected with Encoding (not an image, corrupt, over the limits) or Quota.

Host: Image_decode :: proc(c: ^Call, data: Api_Buffer) -> u64
